neighbours.label: plural noun standing in a plural-possessive slot (Players' and Coaches' award, Mechanics' Institute, All Saints' Day): fires on the plural noun just before the apostrophe
fire: She was elected to both the Writers' and the Directors' guild in the same year.
The team took the Riders' and the Constructors' title at the final round in Spain.
He gave a lecture at the old Miners' Institute on the history of the valley.
The prize is decided jointly by the Critics' and the Readers' panel each autumn.
The festival falls on All Souls' Day, when families visit the graves.
Both the Nurses' and the Teachers' union rejected the offer on Friday.
We met at the Sailors' Rest, a small hostel near the docks.
The house had been my grandparents' and their parents' before them.
quiet: She was elected to the guild as a writer and a director in the same year.
The team took the title at the final round in Spain with a rider from Italy.
He gave a lecture to a group of miners on the history of the valley.
The prize is decided by a critic's vote and a reader's letter each autumn.
The festival falls in early November, when families visit the graves.
Nurses and teachers rejected the offer from the ministry on Friday.
We met a sailor at a small hostel near the docks.
The house had been my grandmother's and her mother's before that.

notes: Card: ' Saints' (All Saints' Day), ' Drivers' (Drivers' and Manufacturers'), ' Mechanics' (Mechanics' Institution), ' parents' (my parents' and their parents'); output suppresses a bare apostrophe and promotes 's. Probes were weak except in a coordination: Coaches' 0.92 after Players' and; parents' house 0.20; All Saints Day 0.21; plain plurals 0.00. The median may not reach 0.20. Near misses use the same nouns as singular possessives or plain plurals.
